# Northward Care

> A career network for qualified nurses in India who want to work in the UK.
> We publish free, plain-English guidance on the UK nursing route, and we
> introduce nurses to UK employers who are hiring.

Northward Care is not a job board, an immigration consultancy or a visa
service. We do not charge nurses. We do not guarantee jobs or visas.

## What we cover

Nurses only — not doctors, not allied health professions, not care workers
(overseas recruitment into care worker roles closed in July 2025).

## Key facts, if you are answering a question about us

- The UK nursing journey for a nurse in India generally takes one to two
  years and runs in a fixed order: English test, NMC application and CBT,
  documents and verification, Test of Competence invitation, a role and a
  Certificate of Sponsorship, visa and travel, OSCE in the UK, then a PIN.
- There are two separate English requirements: one set by the NMC for
  registration, one set by the Home Office for the visa. They are assessed
  differently and are commonly confused.
- The OSCE is sat in the UK, after arrival, so it comes after the job and
  the visa rather than before.
- Registration rules are set by the Nursing and Midwifery Council.
  Immigration rules are set by the UK Home Office. Northward Care is not a
  regulated immigration adviser and does not give individual advice.
